title: 💰 Fixed Salary and Tax Subsidy
summary: Receive a fixed salary based on the number of VIP members in your team
content:
📋 Activity Rules:

  • A fixed salary is distributed once a month on the 1st day (UTC).
  • After meeting the tax subsidy criteria, you can request the subsidy fund during each successful cash-out period.

content:

To thank everyone for their active participation, our online quiz activity has officially been upgraded! Clear rules, generous prizes – everyone is welcome to join on time:

❓ Questions? Ask in the discussion groups.
🍀 Good luck to everyone!

title: 🎟️ 1 ETB Lottery Draw Event
summary: 1,000 ETB prize pool — 1 lucky winner takes all
time: Starts upon launch until all 1,000 tickets are sold (draw at 15:00 UTC the next day)
content:
📜 1 ETB Lottery Draw Event Rules

Article 1: General Overview

This event is a chance-based lottery with a low entry fee of just 1 ETB. Participants purchase entry rights to obtain lottery draw tickets. The total prize pool for this round is 1,000 ETB, which will be awarded in full to 1 lucky winner.

Article 2: Participation Rules

  1. Entry Price: Each lottery ticket costs 1 ETB. Users may purchase multiple tickets — the more tickets purchased, the higher the chance of winning.
  2. Entry Method: After users complete payment through the event page, the system assigns participation numbers in order of transaction time. Each 1 ticket represents 1 unique number. 🔢
  3. Participation Limit: The event ends once all tickets for this round are sold out. Each user may purchase any quantity without a maximum limit.
  4. Eligibility Confirmation: Once the order payment is completed and verified by the system, the user is officially eligible for the lottery draw. ✅

Article 3: Prize Pool & Winner Selection System

  • Prize Pool Amount: The total prize for this round is 1,000 ETB. 💰
  • Number of Winners: This round has only 1 winner, who receives the entire prize pool. 🏆
  • Winning Probability: The winning chance is directly proportional to the number of valid registered tickets held by the user.
  • Drawing Mechanism: The draw is conducted by the system randomly selecting from all valid registered participation numbers. This process is fair, impartial, and cannot be manipulated by human interference. 🤖

Article 4: Draw & Results Announcement

  1. Draw Time: After all 1,000 tickets for this round are completely sold out, the draw will take place the next day at 15:00 (UTC). ⏰
  2. Results Announcement: The winning result will be published on the official channel within 1 hour after the draw. The information disclosed includes the winner's order number and participant name (partially masked). 📢
  3. Prize Distribution: The prize will be fully distributed within 24 hours after the results are announced. 💸

Article 5: Important Notices

  1. This event has no refund policy — once the order payment is verified, the paid amount will not be returned. Please consider carefully before participating.
  2. If any cheating, artificial order manipulation, illegal earning methods, or other improper actions are discovered during the event, the platform reserves the right to cancel the user's participation and winning eligibility, as well as take further legal action. 🚫
  3. The platform reserves the final right of interpretation of these event rules. If any adjustments are made to the rules, they will be announced in advance through official channels.

Note: Participating in this event means that you have read, understood, and fully agreed to all of the above rules. 🤝
